user_question: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

outputs.summary: Workflow completed with accepted terminal artifacts.

workflow_plan.goal: Assign each Centre County hospital to the census tract that contains it and return the tract identifier with each hospital.

workflow_steps.title: Reproject hospital points
workflow_steps.purpose: Transform the hospital point geometries into the census tract layer CRS for a compatible spatial join.
workflow_steps.instructions: Reproject the hospital vector dataset from EPSG:4326 to EPSG:26918. Preserve the hospital attributes and point geometries.

workflow_steps.title: Assign hospitals to containing census tracts
workflow_steps.purpose: Join each hospital point to the census tract polygon that contains it and retain the tract identifier with the hospital attributes.
workflow_steps.instructions: Perform a spatial join between the reprojected hospital points and the census tract polygons. Assign each hospital to the polygon that contains it, preserve the hospital attributes, and include the tract GEOID as the tract identifier in the output.

agent_profile_snapshot.description: Performs deterministic vector geoprocessing including buffering, clipping, overlay/intersection, explicit geometry repair, and spatial joins. skills.name: Vector Geoprocessing
skills.description: Performs spatial buffering, clipping, polygon intersection overlay, geometry validation/repair, and spatial joins.

constraints.spatial: Requires matching coordinate reference systems for binary operations. Distance operations require projected coordinate reference systems.
other: The service performs only the requested operation.
